# Purdue University

> Purdue University is a world-renowned public research institution offering comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs, with strong emphasis on engineering, business, and online education.

Purdue University serves prospective students, current students, faculty, staff, and alumni through integrated portals for admissions, academics, student life, research, and engagement. The university maintains a strong presence in rankings and recognition, with NCAA Division I athletics and extensive campus facilities in West Lafayette, Indiana.

## Key Topics

- Admissions & Applications
- Undergraduate Majors
- Graduate Programs
- Online Education
- Financial Aid & Scholarships

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Apply to Purdue](https://admissions.purdue.edu/become-student/apply): Application portal with deadlines and requirements for first-year and transfer students
- [Become a Student](https://www.purdue.edu/home/become-a-student): Admissions portal with campus visits, majors, and application information
- [Explore 200+ Undergraduate Majors](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/majors/index.php): Directory of undergraduate majors across engineering, business, sciences and more
- [Cost and Financial Aid](https://admissions.purdue.edu/costsandfinaid/index.php): Tuition costs, financial aid options, scholarships and affordability resources
- [Visit Purdue University](https://admissions.purdue.edu/visit/index.php): Campus visit planning: in-person tours, virtual tours and visit scheduling

## Academic Programs

- [Academics at Purdue University](https://www.purdue.edu/home/academics): Academic programs, majors, minors, honors college and learning communities
- [Purdue Online Programs of Study](https://www.purdue.edu/online/programs-of-study): Online degree programs, certificates and professional development courses

## Student Resources & Support

- [Current Students](https://www.purdue.edu/home/current-students): Resources for enrolled students: Blackboard, dining, courses, and financial aid
- [Student Life at Purdue](https://www.purdue.edu/home/life-at-purdue): Student life overview: housing, dining, clubs, recreation and campus experience
- [Faculty and Staff](https://www.purdue.edu/home/faculty-staff): Faculty and staff resources: wellness, professional development, and HR services

## Research & Innovation

- [Research & Partnerships](https://www.purdue.edu/home/research): Research initiatives, innovation, partnerships and faculty achievements

## Community & Engagement

- [About Purdue University](https://www.purdue.edu/home/about): Purdue University history, traditions, leadership and institutional overview
- [Alumni Resources and Giving](https://www.purdue.edu/home/alumni): Alumni network, giving opportunities, engagement and career development
- [Events Calendar](https://events.purdue.edu): University events calendar with filtering and calendar integration options
- [Purdue Newsroom](https://www.purdue.edu/newsroom): Purdue newsroom with university updates, research announcements and stories
